mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts signals a decrease in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST is below 1300 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 5% and a decrease in GDP growth rate signal a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is above 5% and GDPC1 growth rate is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals an increase in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales and an increase in unemployment rate signal a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS growth rate is below 2% and UNRATE is above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
